name: eul
description: Opt-in auto-update downloads a zip and replaces the running app, no signature/checksum (default is notify).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: eul provides an optional application update workflow using a separate bundled helper. The reviewed wrapper does not establish the helper’s full artifact-authentication or product-signing policy.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; helper implementation, package signing, and release-side artifact controls were not independently reviewed.
